purpose: Determine whether a supplied reconciliation receipt is structurally and referentially sufficient to close a specific resolver conflict.
rules: resolves_conflict_id does not equal conflict_id -> FAIL.
Required reconciliation fields missing or malformed -> HOLD.
PASS means reconciliation receipt is applicable to the conflict; it does not validate the external truth of new_state.
A missed deadline alone does not prove external non-response; documented non-response requires its own receipt.

terminal_transition.state_write: append new_state as a new resolver state event
